facts.fact: 反转消化：「就算他不是我的 Marked 我也会选他——我选的是人、不是印」；「a love match, like Eirene and Percival」+「the lack of division between him being two different people」
facts.anchor: I have chosen a man and not a mark.

facts.fact: 马厩惊变：Lumi 藏身 Argus 身侧低声报警「People are in here」——盗马贼正试图给 Draven 的种马上笼头；她放下 Alden 的书空手排查（barefoot、无靴刀——犯了她的第一条规矩）
她的对策：以女性身份为饵——用最柔弱的声音现身（「What are you doing?」）；贼自称 Tantalus、衣下藏甲（重皮革）、评估马的牙口与价值
facts.anchor: I’ll use it. I casually step out from around the corner

facts.fact: Opal 人格重现：谎称是被当作 opal 石头交易来的厨房女仆——「first dress that holds me up like those fancy women」+挺胸展示；故意大声说话（赌 Draven 的听觉）、骗贼送她回 cottage

Draven 入戏：扮 cottage 主人开门——把她像垃圾一样甩到一边（「Here. He says it like I'm of no significance」）；她顺势撕破戏（「I'd rather have a broken leg than have your member beneath me again」）；他单臂拎贼离鞍、确认法律（「sentence…death?」「The Guard and the offended」）后以 wrath 处决——「But you will die because you touched my Marked」
facts.anchor: he literally tosses me aside a good bit of distance

facts.fact: 复盘：她对 Lucan 卫兵下指令移尸（「Horse thief. Name of Tantalus」）；「You don't know all the versions of Commander Theron yet. I was in command—under strain enough for my stone to help. I've been Opal before」；他捏她屁股当「回敬」；「And the fucker stole Jaco's tack」
facts.anchor: I was in command—under strain enough for my stone to help.

facts.fact: Lumi 平安+他的功课：Argus 先察觉唤醒她；父亲去 Rowena 为母亲取药（家中只有她）；Lumi 的凶劲（「He tried to steal the pretty one?」）；他轻声纠正她——「Not all softness is fragility」
facts.anchor: Not all softness is fragility, Lavina,

facts.fact: 他的恐惧自白：「I was scared——你太习惯这个角色，让我开始疑问你以前经历过什么、做过什么」；她答「I am no stranger to the dead.」（ch02 开场句回环）；收束「I feel whole. Not broken.」
facts.anchor: Seeing you take on the energy of a different person showed me how comfortable you are with risking death.
